task.question: In the France vs Spain semifinal on July 14, 2026, which Spanish player was fouled by Lucas Digne to award Spain a penalty in the 22nd minute?
task.evidence: In the 22nd minute, Spain was awarded a penalty when Lucas Digne kicked Lamine Yamal with his swinging left leg when trying to clear the ball. Mikel Oyarzabal scored the penalty with a powerful shot to the right of the net to make it 1–0.
